mentions.name: Software Manager
mentions.description: Software Manager is an open-source tool that catalogs programs, with about 3,750 registered so far and a 2026 goal of 4,000. Data is currently stored in .yml and other flat files, and it can already autogenerate a .sql database, with plans to make the dataset easy to query via oldschool SQL and better optimized. Its long-term goal is to make compilation on any platform dead simple; this works very well on Linux already, though not yet as well on Windows.
mentions.problem: Compilation on any platform is not yet dead simple — Windows support lags behind Linux — and the program dataset currently lives in flat files that are not queried and not optimized.
mentions.source_excerpt:
if I can I still improve my tool called "Software Manager".
Goal for 2026 will be to have registered 4000 programs in total (I am at about
3750 right now) as well as make it dead-easy to interface with it through 
oldschool SQL (right now I just have .yml files and other flat files, though
I can autogenerate a .sql database already as-is, but right now I don't query
this dataset and it is not really optimised either). My long term goal is to 
make compilation on any platform dead simple. On Linux it works very well; 
on windows not quite as well yet.
